```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

# ── Packages ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

sf_use_s2(FALSE)                       # avoid rendering artefacts with BNG
```

```{r paths}
# Resolve project root (two levels up from scripts/)
PROJ <- normalizePath("..")
CSV  <- file.path(PROJ, "output/csv")
SHP  <- file.path(PROJ, "output/shp")
```

---

## 1. Import POI Data

```{r poi}
poi <- read.csv(file.path(CSV, "poi_tesco_stores.csv"))
cat(sprintf("Loaded %d Tesco stores\n", nrow(poi)))
cat("Columns:", paste(names(poi), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Store types:\n")
print(table(poi$store_type))

# Convert to sf points (EPSG:4326) so we can plot on top of shapefiles
poi_sf <- st_as_sf(poi, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
poi_sf <- st_transform(poi_sf, crs = 27700)   # reproject to British National Grid
```

---

## 2. LSOA Level (n ≈ 4 800)

```{r lsoa}
lsoa_shp <- st_read(file.path(SHP, "lsoa_boundaries/lsoa_boundaries.shp"),
                    quiet = TRUE)
lsoa_csv <- read.csv(file.path(CSV, "coverage_lsoa.csv"))

# Shapefile for geometry, CSV for attributes
lsoa <- lsoa_shp %>%
  select(lsoa_code, geometry) %>%
  left_join(lsoa_csv, by = "lsoa_code") %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_coverage)) %>%
  st_make_valid()

cat(sprintf("LSOA units: %d\n", nrow(lsoa)))
cat(sprintf("Coverage: mean = %.1f%%, SD = %.1f%%, range = [%.1f, %.1f]\n",
            mean(lsoa$total_coverage), sd(lsoa$total_coverage),
            min(lsoa$total_coverage), max(lsoa$total_coverage)))
```

```{r lsoa-chloropleth, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 9}
ggplot(lsoa) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = total_coverage), colour = NA, linewidth = 0) +
  geom_sf(data = poi_sf, colour = "black", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 50,
    name = "Coverage\n(% area)",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
    labels = percent_format(scale = 1, suffix = "%")
  ) +
  labs(title = "LSOA Level",
       subtitle = sprintf("n = %d | Mean = %.1f%% | SD = %.1f%%",
                          nrow(lsoa), mean(lsoa$total_coverage),
                          sd(lsoa$total_coverage)),
       caption = "15-min walking isochrone coverage | Black dots = Tesco stores") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position  = "right",
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        axis.text       = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks      = element_blank())
```

## 5. Borough Level (n = 33)

```{r borough}
bor_shp <- st_read(file.path(SHP, "borough_boundaries/borough_boundaries.shp"),
                   quiet = TRUE)
bor_csv <- read.csv(file.path(CSV, "coverage_borough.csv"))

bor <- bor_shp %>%
  select(bor_code, geometry) %>%
  rename(borough_code = bor_code) %>%
  left_join(bor_csv, by = "borough_code") %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_coverage)) %>%
  st_make_valid()

cat(sprintf("Borough units: %d\n", nrow(bor)))
cat(sprintf("Coverage: mean = %.1f%%, SD = %.1f%%, range = [%.1f, %.1f]\n",
            mean(bor$total_coverage), sd(bor$total_coverage),
            min(bor$total_coverage), max(bor$total_coverage)))
```

```{r borough-chloropleth, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 9}
ggplot(bor) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = total_coverage), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = poi_sf, colour = "black", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 50,
    name = "Coverage\n(% area)",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
    labels = percent_format(scale = 1, suffix = "%")
  ) +
  labs(title = "London Borough Level",
       subtitle = sprintf("n = %d | Mean = %.1f%% | SD = %.1f%%",
                          nrow(bor), mean(bor$total_coverage),
                          sd(bor$total_coverage)),
       caption = "15-min walking isochrone coverage | Black dots = Tesco stores") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position  = "right",
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        axis.text       = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks      = element_blank())
```

## 6. Multi-Scale Comparison

```{r helper}
# Reusable choropleth builder (no legend — shared legend on one panel)
make_panel <- function(gdf, title, point_size = 0.3) {
  p <- ggplot(gdf) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = total_coverage), colour = NA, linewidth = 0) +
    geom_sf(data = poi_sf, colour = "black", size = point_size, alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#B2182B",
      midpoint = 50,
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
      labels = percent_format(scale = 1, suffix = "%")
    ) +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = sprintf("n = %d | Mean = %.1f%% | SD = %.1f%%",
                            nrow(gdf),
                            mean(gdf$total_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
                            sd(gdf$total_coverage, na.rm = TRUE))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position  = "none",
          plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
          plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey40"),
          axis.text        = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
          plot.margin      = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "pt"))
  # boundary lines for coarser geographies
  if (nrow(gdf) <= 40) {
    p <- p + geom_sf(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3, fill = NA)
  }
  p
}
```

```{r multiscale, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 14}
p1 <- make_panel(lsoa, "LSOA Level",           point_size = 0.2)
p2 <- make_panel(msoa, "MSOA Level",           point_size = 0.3)
p3 <- make_panel(ward, "Ward Level",           point_size = 0.3)
p4 <- make_panel(bor,  "London Borough Level", point_size = 0.8)

# Shared legend on the MSOA panel
p2 <- p2 +
  theme(legend.position  = "right",
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")) +
  labs(fill = "Coverage\n(% area)")

combined <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Tesco Store Accessibility Across London: Multi-Scale Comparison",
    subtitle = "15-minute walking isochrone coverage (% of area covered by at least one Tesco store)",
    caption  = "LSOA (~1,500 residents) | MSOA (~7,200) | Ward (electoral division) | Borough (~250,000) | Black dots = Tesco stores",
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey40"),
      plot.caption  = element_text(size = 7,  colour = "grey50", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

combined
```
